method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Asian stocks tumble on AI jitters after Samsung forecast; oil stable
Equities.reason: Samsung's guidance/forecast knocked AI/chip optimism, triggering regional equity weakness — a clear negative for risk sentiment and the AI-led market narrative across Asia.

Equities.title: Asian stocks fall as tech selloff sparks sharp KOSPI slump
Equities.summary: Asian equity markets mostly decline on Tuesday as a fresh wave of technology sector selling completely overshadowed Wall Street's tech-led rally from the previous night.
Equities.reason: Tech-led selling dominating regional flow (KOSPI slump) reinforces near-term risk-off in growth/AI sectors — meaningful market-level signal for equities.

Equities.title: Samsung Results Trigger Stock Rotation to Less Loved Sectors
Equities.reason: Article signals a rotation away from AI/chips into cyclicals/’less-loved’ areas after Samsung’s print — a shift that weakens the concentrated AI leadership narrative.

Equities.title: Samsung Electronics shares fall as capex, demand concerns cloud record second-quarter profit report
Equities.summary: Samsung Electronics shares fell even after record preliminary Q2 profit as capex and demand concerns clouded the outlook.
Equities.reason: A major cap-weighted tech name disappointed market positioning despite strong profits — direct negative catalyst for chip/AI sentiment and index performance.

Equities.title: Equities: Semiconductor bounce looks fragile – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists note that the S&P 500 reached a three-week high as chip stocks rebounded, led by gains in the Philly semiconductor index and Broadcom after its expanded Apple partnership.
Equities.reason: Sell-side view that chip rebound is fragile undercuts confidence in sustained tech leadership and raises probability of further volatility in semiconductor-driven rallies.

Equities.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq close sharply higher as Broadcom rallies
Equities.reason: Broadcom-led strength lifted major US indices, showing episodic positive flow into large-cap tech that can offset regional weakness — short-term supportive for risk assets.

Equities.title: US Stocks Fall as Samsung Leads Selloff in Chips: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Sums up selloff transmission from Samsung results into US chip names — reinforces bearish near-term tone for semiconductor-led market segments.

Equities.title: Tech Stocks Extend Rally Ahead of Samsung Earnings, SK Hynix IPO
Equities.reason: Pre-earnings positioning showed continued demand for tech/AI exposure; included as a lower-relevance counter-signal to the selloff narrative.

Equities.title: Wall Street warms to SpaceX ahead of Nasdaq 100 inclusion
Equities.reason: Index inclusion story implies passive/ETF flows and options activity that can buoy large-cap benchmarks — supportive for US equity liquidity and sentiment.

Equities.title: SK Hynix’s Planned $28 Billion Offering Brings Korean Market Fever to the U.S.
Equities.reason: Large issuance/ADR flow links Korean chip capital to US markets — modestly supportive for cross-border tech demand but adds supply/volatility considerations.

Rates.title: New Zealand Dollar: RBNZ hike seen but path questioned – Commerzbank
Rates.summary: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank expects the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) to raise rates at its July meeting to reinforce its inflation-fighting credentials, which should initially support the New Zealand Dollar (NZD).
Rates.reason: Direct central-bank hawkish signal: expectation of an RBNZ rate hike implies higher NZ yields (bond selloff/higher-for-longer). NZ is a smaller market but RBNZ moves feed global rates/generally push yields up; moderate relevance.

Rates.title: New Zealand Set to Raise Key Rate, Decision Less of a Slam Dunk
Rates.reason: Reinforces RBNZ-hike narrative — lifts near-term local yields and supports a slightly higher-for-longer backdrop; lower relevance than primary policy note since it's another confirmation rather than a new central signal.

Rates.title: Japan 30-Year Bond Sale Sees Strongest Demand Since 2019
Rates.reason: Strong demand for long JGBs is supportive for bond prices (lower yields) and signals continued investor appetite for duration; material for global rates given size of JGB market and implications for global flow into safe/long duration assets.

Rates.title: Japan Drives Asia Offshore Bonds to Record, Surpassing China Era
Rates.reason: Record offshore bond activity in Asia (driven by Japan) suggests strong demand/liquidity in regional credit markets which can be mildly supportive for bond prices; relevance moderate because effect is regional and partially issuance-driven.

Rates.title: A Supplement To China Monetary Policy Report--Promoting LPR Reform Orderly
Rates.reason: PBOC guidance on orderly LPR reform is a monetary-policy structural move that could ease lending rates/marketize transmission over time — modestly constructive for Chinese bond prices (yields down) and relevant for Asia rates transmission.

FX.title: British Pound gains as easing Fed hike bets weigh on US Dollar
FX.summary: GBP/USD continues its winning streak for the ninth consecutive day, trading around 1.3390 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Clear USD-softness narrative from fading Fed-hike expectations translating into GBP/USD strength. High direct FX transmission (GBP vs USD) and multi-day momentum make this a material near-term driver for the USD pair.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index holds below 101.00 as fading Fed hike bets counter Hormuz risks
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, struggles for a firm near-term direction and extends its consolidative price moves for the third straight day on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Direct DXY-focused piece showing consolidation and net softening as Fed-hike odds fade (offset by geopolitical risk). Strong USD-centric relevance; supports modest upside for USD-pairs (EUR/GBP/AUD etc.).

FX.title: US Dollar: Crowded support into year-end – NBC
FX.summary: National Bank of Canada ’s (NBC) Stéfane Marion and Kyle Dahms note the US Dollar (USD) is trading near its 2026 high as sticky United States (US) inflation and wider rate differentials underpin the currency.
FX.reason: Macro view explicitly saying sticky US inflation and rate differentials are underpinning the USD. High relevance for FX as it points to persistent USD strength (negative for USD‑pairs) and a broader regime of stronger dollar/positive yield differentials.

FX.title: Iran strikes commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz
FX.summary: Bloomberg carried a story by an Axios reporter late Monday, citing a US official, that Iran fired at least two missiles at commercial ships transiting through the Strait of Hormuz.
FX.reason: Material geopolitical shock with direct safe‑haven and oil‑risk premium implications that historically lift the USD and materally shift FX flows. High relevance due to potential sustained risk‑off and oil‑related FX transmission (higher USD, weaker commodity-linked currencies).

FX.title: Japanese Yen ticks up above 162.00 US Dollar and eases intervention risks
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) posts minor gains amid a somewhat softer US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/JPY pair has pulled back to session lows just below 162.00 from Monday's highs in the 162.40 area, easing concerns about an immediate intervention by the Japane
FX.reason: Direct JPY/USD move with explicit intervention-risk context. Yen appreciation eases one-sided USD/JPY crowding — relevant to flows and BoJ/intervention watchlists. Technical/near-term but clear FX-native transmission.

FX.title: Australian Dollar declines as ANZ–Indeed Job Ads drop in June
FX.summary: AUD/USD inches lower after two days of gains, trading around 0.6950 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) faces downward pressure as weakening economic sentiment amid a cooling labor market signals that high borrowing costs are taking
FX.reason: Domestic data-driven move for AUD vs USD: weaker labour sentiment suggests lower AUD and less chance of local rate support. Direct FX transmission (AUD/USD) with clear macro driver — medium relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee underperforms as oil prices rebound, eyes on FOMC Minutes
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) holds onto Monday’s losses against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: INR weakness tied to oil rebound and USD/Fed minutes watch — relevant for EMFX flows into USD safe‑assets and commodity pass‑through. EMFX but not a primary global pair, so modest relevance.

FX.title: Euro extends the range play above 1.1400 as Hormuz risks support USD
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair extends its sideways consolidative price move during the Asian session on Tuesday, though it manages to hold comfortably above the 1.1400 mark. Moreover, spot prices remain well within striking distance of a nearly two-week high, touched last
FX.reason: EUR/USD technical/range piece that explicitly notes Strait of Hormuz tensions are providing USD support. Direct EUR vs USD transmission — modestly negative for EUR given geopolitics boosting USD flows.

FX.title: Hedge Funds Turn Most Negative on the Japanese Yen Since 2007
FX.reason: Positioning story showing large speculative short JPY bets — a significant structural driver for USD/JPY (JPY weakness). High relevance as extreme positioning can amplify moves and intervention risk dynamics.

FX.title: Euro Summer range holds against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur notes EUR/USD has been stuck between 1.1350 and 1.1450 since mid-June, with few catalysts expected over the summer.
FX.reason: Range-bound EUR/USD assessment from a major bank — signals market inertia and lower likelihood of large directional moves absent macro shocks. Useful background for summer FX positioning (lower immediate impact).

FX.title: British Pound: Strong momentum eyeing 1.3410–1.3445 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights a sharp GBP/USD advance to 1.3397 and a firm close at 1.3391. Intraday, Leang sees scope for further gains toward 1.3410, though 1.3445 may stay out of reach.
FX.reason: Bank technical view on GBP/USD momentum. Price-forecast/technical content (FX-native) — direct transmission to GBP/USD but limited by being an intraday technical call (capped relevance).

Commodities.title: Gold sticks to losses as inflation fears lift US bond yields and USD amid Hormuz risks
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone heading into the European session on Tuesday, albeit it holds above the $4,100 mark. Crude oil prices edge higher amid renewed tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, reviving inflationary concerns.
Commodities.reason: Gold pushed lower as higher U.S. yields and a stronger USD outweigh geopolitical-driven oil/inflation support — dominant narrative: rates/USD pressure on gold.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD corrects further to near $61 as oil prices attract bids
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down 1.35% to near $61.00 during the Asian trading session on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Near-term price/technical update showing downside; linked to oil flows but this is a price-forecast piece so lower relevance.

Commodities.title: WTI rises above $69.00 as Iran strikes commercial vessels in Hormuz
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price gains ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around $69.20 per barrel during the Asian hours on Tuesday. Crude oil prices receive a temporary boost following renewed geopolitical tensions in
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical strike in Strait of Hormuz raises near-term oil risk premium — positive for crude prices and oil-related commodity narratives.

Commodities.title: Gold Steadies as Traders Look to Fed for Interest-Rate Outlook
Commodities.reason: Market waiting on Fed rate outlook keeps gold rangebound with a slight bias lower; reinforces rates/USD as dominant driver for gold.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Drop as Saudi Arabian Price Cut Amplifies Glut Concern
Commodities.reason: Saudi price cut signals stronger competition/oversupply concerns — material negative for oil prices and the broader commodity tone.

Commodities.title: Why oil investors fear the next toll fight could be the Strait of Malacca
Commodities.summary: The prospect of fees to transit the Strait of Hormuz has sparked alarm, not least by investors who fear it could be replicated in other maritime corridors.
Commodities.reason: Discussion of potential transit fees/tolls for key chokepoints raises supply disruption risk premium — modestly positive for oil but speculative.

Commodities.title: Why Iran may find it difficult to clear its oil inventories even after sanctions relief
Commodities.summary: Iran may face challenges in clearing oil inventories even after restrictions have been lifted, amid oil supplies elsewhere while China becomes less enthusiastic
Commodities.reason: Persistent Iranian inventory overhang and weaker offtake prospects argue for continued supply pressure — negative for oil prices.

Commodities.title: U.S. refining capacity decreased during 2025
Commodities.summary: U.S. operable atmospheric distillation capacity, the primary measure of refinery capacity, totaled 18.2 million barrels per calendar day (b/cd) on January 1, 2026-down over 250,000 b/cd (about 1%) compared with January 1, 2025-according to our latest annual Re
Commodities.reason: Declining U.S. refining capacity tightens refined-product markets and can support crude and product prices — constructive fundamental for oil/commodities.

Crypto.title: U.S. inflation outlook underpins bitcoin bulls after best week since March
Crypto.reason: Macro CPI/inflation outlook supportive for risk assets and bitcoin as an inflation hedge; meaningful near-term tailwind for demand and flows—moderately high relevance for crypto market direction.

Crypto.title: Live markets: Bitcoin and ether ETFs drew inflows on Monday
Crypto.reason: Ongoing ETF inflows are a direct, high-impact liquidity source into BTC/ETH markets; recurring positive flow narrative is a major structural driver of price discovery and sentiment.

Crypto.title: Michael Saylor's Strategy dramatically ups pace of bitcoin sales, raising $216 million
Crypto.reason: Large, accelerated institutional sales from a prominent holder materially increase available supply and create headwinds for BTC price; high relevance given size and market signal.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin drops after a run at $64,000, shrugging off Strategy's $213 million BTC sale
Crypto.reason: Near-term price reaction to large selling pressure; relevant as a short-term volatility signal but lower structural importance than flow/regulatory themes.

Crypto.title: DeFi protocol Summer.fi halts Lazy Summer vaults after $6 million exploit
Crypto.reason: Smart-contract exploit and halted vaults undermine DeFi trust and liquidity; negative for risk appetite within altcoin/DeFi segment with moderate relevance.

Crypto.reason: Shifting stablecoin market share toward USDC (more regulated) reduces systemic counterparty concerns and supports broader institutional adoption—meaningful for market structure.

Crypto.title: Tether’s Former CIO Plans Sale of Stake in Stablecoin Giant
Crypto.reason: Insider stake sale in a dominant stablecoin issuer is a governance/ownership signal; limited immediate market impact but creates a small negative governance/confidence datapoint.

Crypto.title: Bitmine added another $74 million in ether as Tom Lee bets on Clarity Act boost
Crypto.reason: Institutional accumulation of ETH increases demand and signals confidence around regulatory clarity (Clarity Act narrative); relevant to ETH flows and price.

Crypto.title: Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum is preparing its 'biggest rebuild' since the Merge
Crypto.reason: Major protocol upgrade talk is a positive long-term fundamental for ETH, supporting developer/network narrative; relevance moderated by execution risk and timeline uncertainty.

Crypto.title: Ripple's preliminary crypto asset provider license in Luxembourg upgraded to fully compliant
Crypto.reason: Regulatory approval in an EU jurisdiction reduces legal/regulatory overhang for Ripple and is constructive for XRP adoption; moderate relevance to market/regulatory landscape.

Crypto.title: Russia's largest bank plans crypto wallet launch as Moscow clears market path
Crypto.reason: Mainstream banking entry into crypto in a large market signals adoption and client access expansion; positive adoption datapoint though geopolitically mixed and region-specific.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's U.S. reserve still a work-in-progress as federal agencies hash it out
Crypto.reason: Ongoing inter-agency uncertainty about a U.S. bitcoin reserve raises regulatory/custody uncertainty that can weigh on institutional adoption—moderate negative signal.

Crypto.title: Crypto bounces back from the brink as altcoin optimism returns despite pockets of weakness
Crypto.reason: Market-wide recovery and renewed altcoin optimism is a positive sentiment signal across crypto, though heterogenous by token and tempered by specific risks.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin miner TeraWulf soars on a $19 billion AI data-center lease with Anthropic
Crypto.reason: Miner diversification into AI data centers highlights new revenue models for mining firms and institutional interest; small positive for miner equities and ecosystem funding, limited direct BTC impact.
